# Subway Seat for Hyper

Colors, cursor, selection, borders and the tab strip. Hyper 3 loads local plugins from `~/.hyper_plugins/local/`; the Hyper 4 canary uses `~/.config/Hyper/plugins/local/`.

[Hyper](https://hyper.is) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/hyper/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat/index.js`](subway-seat/index.js) | `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat/index.js` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel/index.js`](subway-seat-tunnel/index.js) | `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-tunnel/index.js` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel/index.js`](subway-seat-enamel/index.js) | `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-enamel/index.js` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat'],
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat-tunnel'],
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat-enamel'],
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-tunnel/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-enamel/index.js`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
